title: AI Response Quality & Chat Formatting Improvements
description: Major improvements to AI query generation, response formatting, and chat message display quality.

items.title: AI Query Generation Improvements
items.description: Significantly enhanced the AI's ability to generate accurate database queries
details: Added intelligent company/supplier name matching with partial string matching
Implemented case-insensitive search for company names (TechCorp, techcorp, TECHCORP all match)
Added support for status/enum field queries (e.g., 'cancelled orders', 'pending tasks')
Improved 'how many' question handling to return actual data instead of just counts
Enhanced world knowledge integration for better query interpretation

items.title: SurrealDB Query Syntax Fixes
items.description: Corrected AI-generated queries to use proper SurrealDB syntax
details: Fixed company name matching to use 'CONTAINS' instead of unsupported 'LIKE' operator
Implemented case-insensitive matching with string::lowercase() function
Added regex pattern matching support with ~ operator
Prevented AI from generating invalid LIKE queries for SurrealDB

items.title: AI Response Formatting
items.description: Fixed formatting issues in AI responses across chat and analysis
details: Fixed chat message bubbles to properly display line breaks and formatting
Corrected AI analysis panel to extract 'answer' field from JSON responses
Added automatic conversion of escaped newlines (\n) to actual line breaks
Ensured consistent formatting between chat bubbles and analysis panels

items.title: Query Generation Accuracy
items.description: Improved AI's understanding of query requirements
details: Added concrete examples for company/supplier queries in AI prompts
Enhanced status field query examples (cancelled, pending, completed)
Strengthened 'how many' rules to prevent count-only responses
Added explicit guidance against using RETURN array::len() for data queries

items.title: Fixed AI Analysis Response Extraction
items.description: Backend now properly extracts 'answer' field from AI analysis JSON responses

items.title: Fixed Chat Message Formatting
items.description: Chat bubbles now display properly formatted text with line breaks

items.title: Fixed Company Name Query Generation
items.description: AI now generates queries that find company names regardless of capitalization

items.title: Fixed Status Field Queries
items.description: AI now properly filters by status fields instead of returning all records

items.title: Enhanced AI Prompt Engineering
items.description: Improved system prompts for better query generation
details: Added company/supplier name handling to world knowledge section
Included concrete examples for common query patterns
Strengthened rules against count-only responses
Added SurrealDB-specific syntax guidance

items.title: Backend Response Processing
items.description: Improved AI response parsing and extraction
details: Enhanced JSON response parsing to handle multiple field names
Added fallback logic for different response formats
Improved error handling for malformed AI responses

items.title: Frontend Display Logic
items.description: Better formatting and display of AI-generated content
details: Added content preprocessing for chat messages
Implemented proper newline conversion
Maintained whitespace-pre-wrap for formatting preservation
